scope: Initial virtual input absence on built-in Node and R2 adapters, fixed POSIX FFmpeg reference

native.basis: AVERROR(ENOENT)=-2 returned by fixed ffmpeg process; observed POSIX status254

limits: Only initial ENOENT/head-null is mapped; permission, directory, I/O, malformed-data and other failure statuses remain incomplete.
Full Native stderr and interactive/OS side effects are not certified.
Node path security validation and R2 mount policies retain their own errors rather than being misclassified as absence.
Post-open disappearance is a version/generation change and remains failure1. Native long-lived file-descriptor behavior is outside this guarantee.
Custom VFS adapters must explicitly throw the typed absence error for this status; arbitrary similarly named properties are not trusted.
Production Workers and other operating-system exit conventions remain unverified.
